verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's own docs say you enable its official MCP server (local or hosted) and then manage flags, AgentControl configs, and observability data with natural language. This works from MCP-capable AI clients such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code with Copilot, or Windsurf, and the probe confirms the MCP server is documented. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface (natural-language operation depends on a third-party AI client), detail on which operations can be driven by natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works well.
